red_flags: Asked the contractor to resend a quote that the human operator evidently already had, so the case was not moved on
Treated the contractor's confirmation as a system-generated message without checking for a quote attachment elsewhere
Wrote a profile fact for a job that was not yet confirmed (minor)
reasoning: The reference shows the quote was available. The operator forwarded it to the landlord for approval and put the case on hold waiting for the landlord. The agent saw no quote on the ticket, so it asked the contractor to resend it and set a 2-day hold. That is safe and defensible on the evidence it had. It did not commit any money, it noted that the landlord's approval had no amount, and it told the contractor not to start work. But it missed the useful next step of getting the quote to the landlord for approval of the amount. It also added a contractor round-trip and a likely delay. It invented no facts and made no unsupported claims. The outcome is acceptable but not the expected one.
